Global Digital - Senior Data Analyst, Specialized Bicycle Components — Oct 2022 - Mar 2026

Led analytics initiatives for the global digital business, supporting reporting, analysis, and insight generation across marketing, product, operations, finance, and executive leadership.
Partnered with technology & business leaders to design data solutions that give visibility into operational performance for major global initiatives.
Positioned Global Digital as a leader in data-driven operations, leading to requests for support & guidance across the organization.
Architected tracking for the global ecommerce site, designing the data layer and implementation across 30+ ecommerce-enabled countries.
Engineered product datasets using SQL & ETL tools, combining 10+ data sources, enabling end-to-end visibility into product movement from manufacturer to warehouse to customer.
Analyzed customers subscribed to marketing, finding they had +47% higher LTV than non-subscribed customers, so the business increased focus on growing subscriptions.
Reduced manual reporting by 50% across the Global Digital business, creating self-serve reports supported by robust documentation.
Identified $2M in annual revenue leakage from a global promotion change; presented analysis to Chief Digital Officer that led to reversal and recaptured revenue.
Connected online behavior to retail purchases by writing complex SQL that gave executive leadership insight into omnichannel customer journey for the first time.
Mentored junior analysts, supporting growth & advancing analytical output.
